verdict.rationale: Agents are plain Python/Node.js programs that join rooms as programmatic participants, so they run headlessly by design. Behavioral tests and LLM-driven simulations plug into pytest/Vitest suites, which fits CI. Hands-on probes show the official `lk` CLI runs without a key, `livekit-server --dev` boots with no account, and `pip install livekit-agents` imports with no key, so an unattended CI environment is feasible. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive CLI deploy/automation commands, and independent reports of CI usage.
